title: Dimethyl sulfide found on exoplanets as a sign of life elsewhere

tellings.quote: 120 uh light years away from us like we we found some dimethyl sulfide the dimethyl dulfide

plain: Scientists have found a chemical called dimethyl sulfide on planets circling other stars, some 120 to 240 light years from Earth, according to a researcher named Chris Gilbert. He mentions it in passing on Michels's show without naming a source, and he treats it as a possible sign that life exists beyond Earth.
